+---

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8480'
+title: Cover the zero-config default on-device path end to end
+---
+## What
+
+Two uncovered regions, one cause — nothing ever runs the package's own advertised default path.
+
+`Sources/FoundationModelsRanker/Searcher.swift:101-103` — 96.0% (120/125). Uncovered: 101-103.
+
+```swift
+public static let defaultSessionFactory: @Sendable (String) -> any AgentSession = { instructions in
+    LanguageModelSession(model: .default, instructions: instructions)   // uncovered
+}
+```
+
+`Examples/FullMontyCore/Demo.swift:166-169` — 87.1% (54/62). Uncovered: 140, 166-169, 223-225.
+
+```swift
+public func runDefaultDemo(
+    onDiagnostic: @escaping @Sendable (RankDiagnostic) -> Void = { _ in }
+) async throws -> [FullMontyResult] {
+    try await runFullMontyDemo(embedder: nil, session: Searcher.defaultSessionFactory, mode: .auto, onDiagnostic: onDiagnostic)
+}
+```
+
+`Searcher.defaultSessionFactory` is the default value of `Searcher.init`'s `session:` parameter. It is what `try await Searcher(items)` — the README's lead example, the package's front door — actually uses. Every existing test passes an explicit scripted session, so the real default has never executed in a test.
+
+This is the path that was silently broken until commit `cbcee8c`: every query returned no matches because the prompt showed the model no ids. That bug survived because nothing tested this path. A test here is the regression guard for it.
+
+Apple Intelligence is available on the development machine — verified, a real `SystemLanguageModel` session answers in about 1.9 seconds.
+
+Also fold in the two trivial leftovers in the same file while you are there: `Demo.swift:140` (the default `onDiagnostic` argument of `runEmbedderDemo`, uncovered because every caller passes one) and `Demo.swift:223-225` (`printDiagnostic`, never called by a test).
+
+## Constraint — keep the real-model parts gated
+
+CI has no Apple Intelligence; its integration job is skipped on every run. Gate anything that touches the on-device model with `.enabled(if: isFoundationModelsRankerIntegrationEnabled)`. The two trivial leftovers need no gate.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A gated test calls `try await Searcher(items)` with NO `session:` argument, so `defaultSessionFactory` is what constructs the session, and gets back at least one match.
+- [ ] A gated test calls `runDefaultDemo` and gets one result per demo query.
+- [ ] `Searcher.swift:101-103` and `Demo.swift:140`, `166-169`, `223-225` are all covered. Confirm by re-running coverage, not by inspection.
+- [ ] A plain `swift test` with the variable unset still reports zero failures.
+- [ ] No production code changes. Tests only.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Gated, in `Tests/FoundationModelsRankerTests/SearcherTests.swift`: the zero-config `Searcher(items)` returns a match for a query whose answer is unambiguous in the fixture catalog, and reports no `.unknownSelectedId` diagnostic. The absence of that diagnostic is the regression guard for the `cbcee8c` bug.
+- [ ] Gated, in `Tests/FoundationModelsRankerTests/ExamplesSmokeTests.swift`: `runDefaultDemo` returns one `FullMontyResult` per demo query.
+- [ ] Ungated: `runEmbedderDemo()` called with no argument, exercising its default `onDiagnostic`.
+- [ ] Ungated: `printDiagnostic` runs for each `RankDiagnostic` case without trapping.
+- [ ] Report both runs in the step record: with the variable set, and with it unset.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #coverage-gap
\ No newline at end of file
